characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Unless this model is fleeing or engaged in combat, once per turn a friendly model that is within its Command range may re-roll one Scatter dice or one Artillery dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this model miscasts a spell, it must immediately make a Toughness test. If this test is failed, it loses a single Wound and gains a +1 modifier to its Toughness characteristic instead of rolling on the Miscast table. If this test is passed, it rolls on the Miscast table as normal.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Unless this unit is fleeing, any friendly unit that is within 6" of this unit and that has the Levies special rule may re-roll a failed Panic test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During the Movement phase, up to two friendly war machines with the ‘Steam Carriage’ upgrade that are completely within this model’s rear arc and within 8" of its base at the beginning of the phase may replace their Movement characteristic with this model’s. These war machines must finish their movement completely within this model’s rear arc and within 8" of its base. Unless this model moves using the Lumbering Destruction special rule or makes a charge move, these war machines are not considered to have moved this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Stomp Attacks made by an Iron Daemon have an Armour Piercing characteristic of -2.

However, this rule cannot be used against models whose troop type is ‘behemoth’ – they are simply too large to be caught beneath an Iron Daemon’s wheels.

In addition, and unlike other chariots, this model treats low linear obstacles as open terrain rather than as impassable terrain.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During the Combat phase, any enemy model that uses a magic weapon to attack a character mounted on a Lammasu counts as being armed with a simple hand weapon instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If a unit with this special rule is engaged with an enemy unit’s flank or rear arc, it may re-roll any failed rolls To Hit made against that enemy unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A model with this special rule improves their armor value by 1 and has a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, a Wizard with this special rule may wear armour without penalty.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each combat phase, during Step 1.1 of the Choose Combat & Fight sub-phase, before issuing challenges, any model (friend or foe) that is in base contact with this model and that does not also have this special rule suffers a single Strength 4 hit with an AP of -1. This hit has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A hand weapon carried by a model with this special rule has the Magical Attacks special rule and an Armour Piercing characteristic of -1.

Note that this special rule only applies to a single, non-magical hand weapon and does not apply to a model’s mount (should it have one). If the model is using two hand weapons or any other sort of weapon, this special rule ceases to apply.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A Hellbound model has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and gains both the Fear and Magical Attacks special rules. If the model already has the Fear special rule, it instead gains the Terror special rule. Additionally, once per game, a Hellbound model may re-roll one Scatter dice or one Artillery dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Models with this special rule suffer a -1 modifier to the result of any Flee roll or Pursuit roll they make (to a minimum of 1).

Note that this modifier does not apply to mounted characters.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Impact Hits caused by a model with this special rule have an Armour Piercing characteristic of -2.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: A Lammasu may make one additional attack each turn with this weapon.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Armour Bane (1), Bombardment, Cumbersome, Move or Shoot, Multiple Wounds (D6)

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the ‘Bombardment’ special rule, a 3" blast template and the Black Powder Misfire table. The Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule applies only to a single model whose base lies underneath the central hole of the blast template.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Armour Bane (1), Bombardment, Cumbersome, Flaming Attacks, Move or Shoot

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the ‘Bombardment’ special rule, a 5" blast template and the Black Powder Misfire table. Any unit that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from this weapon must make a Panic test as if it had taken heavy casualties.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Bombardment, Cumbersome, Quake, Move or Shoot, Multiple Wounds (D3+1)

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: This weapon shoots like a stone thrower, using the ‘Bombardment’ special rule, a 5" blast template and the Black Powder Misfire table. The Multiple Wounds (D3+1) special rule applies only to a single model whose base lies underneath the central hole of the blast template.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: An Iron Daemon cannot march. Instead, you may roll a D6 and add its result to the model's Movement characteristic. However, if a natural 1 is rolled when making this roll, something has gone wrong deep within the infernal machine, rendering it immobile. The Iron Daemon halts immediately and cannot move again for the remainder of this turn.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: In combat, this model may make one of its attacks each turn with this weapon.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: When shooting with a steam cannonade, follow the normal Shooting phase sequence. This weapon does not have a 360° line of sight, it can only shoot into the Iron Daemon’s front arc.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A Wizard with the ‘Lore of Hashut’ special rule may discard one of their randomly generated spells as normal. When they do so, they may select instead either the signature spell of their chosen Lore of Magic, or one of the spells listed below:

• Curse Of Hashut 
• Storm Of Ash 
• Flames Of Hashut

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Armour Bane (1), Flaming Attacks, Move & Shoot, Quick Shot

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: If the roll To Hit is successful, a naptha bomb causes D3+1 hits to the target enemy unit, rather than the usual one.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: A model armed with a Hailshot blunderbuss suffers no negative modifiers for firing at long range, for using the Multiple Shots (D3) special rule, or whilst making a Stand & Shoot charge reaction. In addition, if 10 or more models belonging to the same unit shoot at the same target with Hailshot blunderbusses, they may re-roll any rolls of a natural 1 when rolling To Wound.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text:
Single use. Instead of attacking normally during the Combat phase, a model equipped with one or more vials of the Blood of Hashut can make a single attack to expend one vial. Make a single roll To Hit. If successful, the enemy suffers D6 hits. These hits can be directed against a unit or against a single enemy model. 

When rolling To Wound, the target number is the same as the armour value of the model(s) hit. For example, if the model(s) hit wear heavy armour, the target number for the rolls To Wound would be 5+, the same as the armour value of heavy armour. No armour save is permitted against wounds caused by the Blood of Hashut (Ward and Regeneration saves can be attempted as normal). Hits caused by the Blood of Hashut have the Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: An Iron Daemon equipped with a Skullcracker replaces the Impact Hits (D6+1) special rule with the Impact Hits (2D6+2) special rule and the Stomp Attacks (D3+1) with the Stomp Attacks (D6+1) special rule and gains the Armour Bane (1) special rule.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text:
A Darkforged weapon is a hand weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule and can be used in conjunction with the Ensorcelled Weapons special rule. In addition, after deployment but before the first turn begins, roll on the table below to determine an attribute for the weapon. The weapon has this attribute for the duration of the battle:

1-2: Malignant: The bearer of this weapon gains the Hatred (all enemies) special rule.
3-4: Life Bane: This weapon gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.
5-6: Spell-wrought: If the bearer of this weapon is a Wizard, they may apply a +1 modifier to any Casting roll they make. If the bearer of this weapon is not a Wizard, this weapon has a Strength characteristic of S+1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A Bale Taurus or Great Taurus has a 3+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the Command sub-phase of their turn, this character may attempt to urge those around them into battle with a lash of their whip by making a Leadership test. If passed, a single friendly Infantry or Cavalry unit within their command range gains a +D3 modifier to their Movement characteristic (to a maximum of 10). 


Note that this special rule is not cumulative. In other words, using it more than once on the same unit during the same turn has no further effect.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: A Fireglaive has two profiles, representing its duality of purpose as both a ranged and combat weapon

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game during the Command sub-phase of their turn, this character may attempt to drive a unit they have joined to greater efforts by making a Leadership test (using their own Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase this character and any unit they have joined gains the Extra Attacks (+1) and Hatred (all enemies) special rules.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Quake: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, any unit (friend or foe) that was within 2D6" of the central hole of a blast template after scattering fired from one or more Dreadquake mortars, suffers a -1 modifier to its Movement characteristic and cannot use the Swiftstride special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If an Ogre Loader is equipped with Naptha bombs, the crew of the war machine that the Ogre Loader is joined with is also equipped with Naptha bombs.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The crew of a war machine joined by an Ogre Loader gains a +1 modifier to its Movement characteristic and the Stubborn special rule. In addition, once per game, a war machine that includes an Ogre Loader may fire twice during the Shooting phase, or re-roll a single artillery dice.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A unit with this special rule can Volley Fire during a turn in which it moved, or whilst performing a Stand & Shoot charge reaction.

profiles.name: Claws and fangs (counts as hand weapon)
